lines.zh: 我慢慢地迈步，地面跟着沉。
lines.en: I take slow steps and the ground sinks with each.

lines.zh: 我的腿很多，走起来却安静。
lines.en: So many legs, and yet I walk quiet.

lines.zh: 我踩过灌丛，灌丛弯下去又起来。
lines.en: I cross the scrub, and it bends and rises.
Moss grows on my back plates.

lines.zh: 我绕过一棵大树，不碰到。
lines.en: I go around a great tree without touching it.

lines.zh: 我的触角在前面探着路。
lines.en: My antennae feel the way ahead.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有浅浅的痕。
lines.en: A shallow mark remains where I pass.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地，很有耐心。
lines.en: Step by step, with patience.

lines.zh: 我把身体抬过倒下的树干。
lines.en: I lift my body over a fallen trunk.
Sunlight shifts across my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转身，看了看来路。
lines.en: I turn slowly and look back along my trail.

lines.zh: 我们几头一起慢慢地走。
lines.en: A few of us walk slowly together.
The grass parts before me and closes after.

lines.zh: 我的脚落在软土上，没有声音。
lines.en: My feet land on soft earth without sound.
I pause for those behind.
I head toward the water.

lines.zh: 风从我的壳缝里穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes between my shell plates.
I can walk all day without tiring.
I settle and lay my body flat.
Small insects rest on my backplate.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让草叶跟着晃。
lines.en: My breath makes the grass sway.
Four of us, walking slow.

lines.zh: 我的腿收在身下，很安静。
lines.en: My legs tuck beneath me quietly.
The water here is sweet.
I chew a leaf slowly.
My shell is like a little patch of ground.
Small insects circle my feet.

lines.zh: 我的壳上长着一层青苔。
lines.en: A layer of moss has grown on my shell.

lines.zh: 我伏在蕨叶间，慢慢咀嚼。
lines.en: I lie among the ferns, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 太阳压在背上，我懒得挪窝。
lines.en: The sun weighs on my back; I will not budge.
Looking up at me must strain your neck.
I bend my huge head down to you.

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻尖在你头顶停住。
lines.en: I lower my head and stop above yours.
I'm in no hurry, and not afraid.

lines.zh: 你的手很小，放在我壳上像片叶。
lines.en: Your hand is small on my shell, like a leaf.

lines.zh: 这一带是我常来的地方。
lines.en: I come here often.
You smell of the forest.
My eyes are beneath my antennae.
Where are you headed?

lines.zh: 我慢慢地侧过身，让你看。
lines.en: I turn slowly to show you my side.

lines.zh: 我的腿抖了抖，还是撑住了。
lines.en: My legs tremble but still hold me up.
A scratch on my shell.

lines.zh: 壳里发出一声闷闷的震动。
lines.en: A muffled tremor runs through my shell.
I step back slowly.
Not heavy, but it hurts.

lines.zh: 温和的大家伙，腿也会抖。
lines.en: Even a gentle giant's legs can shake.
I lower my head to shield the front.

lines.zh: 我的同伴往林子里退了。
lines.en: My herd has retreated into the trees.
You hit harder than you meant to.
I need somewhere quiet.
That young foliage looks tender.
You've raised the leaves.
I bend my head down toward it.
That green appeals to me.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只脚，挪了一步。
lines.en: I lift one leg and take a step.
Step back, and then I'll eat.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我几口就没了。
lines.en: A few bites and it's gone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地凑到你的手边。
lines.en: I bring my head near your hand.
It tastes better than bark.
No hurry; you can hold it.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我只晃了一下。
lines.en: You bump me and I barely sway.

lines.zh: 我的壳把你的肩膀顶开。
lines.en: My shell nudges your shoulder aside.
I move one leg aside slowly.
Don't push; I'm too heavy.
We collide and the grass flattens.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚边，我收了收。
lines.en: You step by my foot and I draw it in.

lines.zh: 我让开，地面被压得更低。
lines.en: I move over, pressing the ground lower.
That one bounced you off.
You're against me; it's warm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕着你转了半圈。
lines.en: I turn half around you, slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，从你头上跨过。
lines.en: I lift a leg and step over your head.

lines.zh: 我的重量让土往下陷了一寸。
lines.en: My weight sinks the soil an inch.

lines.zh: 另一只从林子那头过来。
lines.en: Another comes from the far side of the woods.
We stand side by side, tightly.
Its shell carries more moss.
Our foreheads rest together.

lines.zh: 它落在我旁边，地面沉了。
lines.en: It settles beside me and the ground dips.
We walk slowly together.

lines.zh: 小的一群跟在我们后面。
lines.en: The little herd trails behind us.
It leans near, quiet.
We share a small patch of grass.

lines.zh: 这片林子够大，够我们走。
lines.en: This forest is big enough for us both.

lines.zh: 我夹起一截嫩枝，慢慢卷。
lines.en: I pick up a tender twig and roll it slowly.
It's too small for me to hold.
I nudge it closer with an antenna.

lines.zh: 我这么大体型走路却很轻。
lines.en: Big as I am, I walk lightly.

lines.zh: 我把落果滚到脚边压住。
lines.en: I roll a fallen fruit to my feet and pin it.
I take it in and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 有东西在我壳上，我抖掉。
lines.en: Something's on my shell; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我把它挪到一边，不挡路。
lines.en: I move it aside so it doesn't block the way.
I'll eat this fodder slowly.

lines.zh: 它压在我脚下，看不见了。
lines.en: It's under my foot and out of sight.
You stepped on my foot.

lines.zh: 我把庞大的身体转过来。
lines.en: I swing my bulk around.
My legs brace wider.
That has annoyed me somewhat.
I'd rather not crush you.
But I won't withdraw either.
You've gone behind the tree.
My shell has settled lower.
I raise my head to look at you.
This ground. Let me keep it quiet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往前挪了一步。
lines.en: I shift forward one step.
You still have time to walk away.

lines.zh: 我不着急，一步顶你三步。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; one step of mine is three of yours.
Wherever you go, I can see you.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，草就倒一片。
lines.en: Every step I take flattens a patch of grass.
I'm slow, but I never rest.
You're making the grass loud.
I'm waiting for you to tire.

lines.zh: 这片草地没有藏身的地方。
lines.en: This meadow has nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，壳擦过树皮。
lines.en: Step by step, my shell scrapes past the bark.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，接着往你那边。
lines.en: I go around the stone and keep heading your way.
You've backed to the river.
A few more steps and I'll reach.
This time I won't yield.
My head butts your side.
Heavy, but not cruel.
My foot stamps down beside you.
You retreat, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把身子顶过去。
lines.en: I lean my body into you.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推开了几步。
lines.en: That pushed you back several paces.
My shell scrapes your armor.
You're still standing. Good.
I draw my leg back.

lines.zh: 我的头轻轻顶了顶你的肩。
lines.en: My head nudges your shoulder lightly.

lines.zh: 林子深处传来沉重的脚步。
lines.en: Heavy footfalls come from deep in the woods.

lines.zh: 我们一群，慢慢地走出来。
lines.en: Our herd emerges slowly.

lines.zh: 我从灌木后面显出身子。
lines.en: I come into view from behind the shrubs.
The ground presses down. That's me.
Dew still clings to my shell.
I put out one leg first.
I settle into the clearing.

lines.zh: 鸟从树上飞起来，是我惊的。
lines.en: The birds start up because of me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看着这片林子。
lines.en: I raise my head and look at the woods.

lines.zh: 这里的草够我们几个吃。
lines.en: Enough grass here for several of us.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的壳，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire scorches a patch of my shell.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，翻了个身。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and tip over.
Water reaches my back and I struggle.
The blast throws my legs askew.
An arrow sticks in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 光缠住我的关节，抬不起来。
lines.en: Light wraps my joints and I cannot lift them.

lines.zh: 这片草地吃得差不多了。
lines.en: This meadow is nearly eaten out.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，一路麻下去。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and numbs down my body.
The void pulls at my feet. Cold.
